mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, the temperature is 64 degrees under moderate rain at Reddan Soccer Park.

The city is excited to welcome Liz Gay as the new Deputy Chief of Administration for EMS. She joins us with an extensive background in emergency services and public safety leadership. Additionally, the Public Works Department reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles local refuse and recycling, so be sure to check your collection schedules and cart placement rules online.

We have a busy schedule of trivia tonight with events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's all happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a recent report, officers noted that on October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were cited for riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive after previously being warned.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
